paper_title: Search for hidden-photon cold dark matter using a K-band cryogenic receiver
notes: Hidden-photon CDM dish-antenna search with cryogenic K-band receiver. Limit chi < 1.8-4.3e-10 over mass range 115.79-115.85 ueV (27.998-28.012 GHz). Exact chi(m) shape not tabulated; endpoints represent the stated range boundaries. DM density 0.39 GeV/cm^3.
